brief: LLM serving without the GPU rental tax — 6 patterns running in prod.

slots.codeComment: // deploy LLMs without the cloud GPU markup

slots.title: Shrink weights
slots.subtitle: Drop precision, not accuracy, and fit massive models into commodity RAM.
slots.b1Body: Weights compress to a quarter with negligible perplexity hit.
slots.b2Body: llama.cpp turns any server into a host without a GPU.
slots.b3Body: Smaller files mean cold-start times drop by sixty percent.

slots.title: Cache keys
slots.subtitle: Reuse attention states across turns instead of recomputing from scratch every request.
slots.b1Body: Skip redundant matrix math by storing KV pairs per session.
slots.b2Body: Streaming cache lets you keep 128k tokens alive at once.
slots.b3Body: Second prompt returns in milliseconds because the graph is warm.

slots.title: Draft tokens
slots.subtitle: A tiny model guesses the next words so the big one verifies batches faster.
slots.b1Body: A 1B parameter assistant predicts three steps ahead for free.
slots.b2Body: The main network checks guesses in a single batched forward pass.
slots.b3Body: Acceptance rates above eighty percent mean fewer forward passes total.

slots.title: Split layers
slots.subtitle: ExLlama maps transformer layers between VRAM and system memory on demand.
slots.b1Body: Hot layers live on GPU while cold weights stay in RAM.
slots.b2Body: Consumer cards with 24 GB VRAM can host models ten times larger.
slots.b3Body: Stop renting A100s when your workstation can serve the same traffic.

slots.title: Pack requests
slots.subtitle: vLLM squeezes concurrent users into the same GPU memory footprint with paging.
slots.b1Body: New prompts join the active batch without waiting for others to finish.
slots.b2Body: Memory blocks allocate dynamically so KV cache never reserves empty padding space.
slots.b3Body: One cheap GPU now serves the traffic of three dedicated instances.

slots.title: Ship models
slots.subtitle: ONNX and llama.cpp let you serve inference on bare metal without cloud GPUs.
slots.b1Body: Keep data inside your network and skip every API egress fee.
slots.b2Body: Neon and Metal backends unlock phones and tablets as silent workers.
slots.b3Body: You bought the hardware once, so inference is now pure margin.

slots.ctaBody: Cut your inference bill by ninety percent with these production-tested patterns. Deploy once, own forever.
